title: ProteinScope

provenance.origin: github.com/UndidIridium/proteinscope at f3df25882d01, personal (personal: "cryo-em" "single html file" in:readme,description archived:false (page 1))

notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). Type one protein identifier (gene symbol, UniProt accession or PDB code) and get a single dashboard that pulls together UniProt function and curation status, ranked PDB structures with a 3D viewer, the STRING interaction network, InterPro domains, Reactome pathways, CATH/SCOP classification, subcellular localization, diseases, references and the sequence with FASTA export. Data used in the run: example. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
